personalInfo.name: Areeb Khan
personalInfo.headline: TypeScript · Node.js · React · React Native
personalInfo.valueProposition: I design and ship products across the full stack, from Node.js services, data models and authentication to React and React Native interfaces, and put the tooling in place that keeps teams shipping.
personalInfo.summary: Full-stack software engineer since 2019, working fully remote with clients in Israel, Malaysia and India. I currently lead front-end on Reeco's hospitality procurement marketplace (web and mobile), and work across the stack: Node.js and Express services on MongoDB, JWT and session-based authentication, role-based access control and offline-first data layers. I also ship production software by directing AI coding agents, with custom agent skills and rigorous reviews in place of hand-written code. Past work includes a traceability platform that gave 5M+ products a unique identity and a blockchain app inaugurated by the Dalai Lama.

achievements: Delivered the customer-facing Buyer app, a **B2B marketplace** connecting hotels with suppliers, by building its Store, multi-stage Orders and Accounts Payable (invoices, statements) modules in **React** and **TypeScript** with **role-based access control (RBAC)**; the platform serves 3,700+ users across 1,000+ properties for 100+ corporate clients and has processed 24,000+ invoices worth $42M+.

Launched Reeco's mobile app, built from scratch in **React Native** with **offline support** and **optimistic updates**, shipping stable **Android** and **iOS** releases that keep ordering reliable on unstable hotel networks; oversaw subsequent versions.

Shipped the Corporate Platform app for multi-property oversight with zero hand-written code, directing **AI coding agents** end to end through custom **agent skills** and review gates on every change; the app is stable in production and buyers are adopting it.
Rebuilt the company website on a **headless CMS** that I proposed and integrated, so the business publishes content without engineering involvement.

As lead front-end developer, screen and review **pull requests** from an 11-developer front-end team across Reeco's repositories, holding the bar on code quality, architecture and consistency while mentoring the team.
Partner with the product designer in iterative back-and-forth reviews, turning designs into production UI and feeding implementation constraints and edge cases back into the design.
Joined Reeco directly after building its Back Office, Seller and Buyer apps through CAW Studios.
Implemented **session-based authentication** in the sign-up flow of the **Node.js** back-end SDK, making sign-up safer and smoother for applications built on SuperTokens.

Built and launched SuperTokens' public **JWT** encoder/decoder, with signature validation across 6 algorithms (**HS256**, **HS384**, **HS512**, **ES256**, **RS256**, **PS256**), giving developers a way to debug tokens on the company site.
Migrated legacy front-end code to the latest SDK version, added theming support to the sign-up page and fixed UI defects in the user-management dashboard.

Launched BeTagged, a social-media marketing platform for a Malaysian client, by leading a 6-developer front-end team that built its **TypeScript** and **React** web app from scratch, mentoring them through daily code reviews.
Eliminated duplicated business logic between the web and mobile apps by setting up and managing a **Lerna** monorepo and co-leading the shared-code effort.
Designed a single cross-platform logging setup with **Segment** and **Sentry**, later adopted as the organisation's logging blueprint.

Cut wait times across Reeco's three procurement apps (Back Office, Seller, Buyer) with optimistic updates and response caching in **TanStack Query**, and built a shared **Storybook** component library.

Increased daily label-printing throughput by more than 60% by architecting a **Node.js** print driver and **React** dashboard (**Express**, **MongoDB**, **Puppeteer**) that automated QR-coded label generation and replaced a slow proprietary process.

Gave 5M+ products farm-to-fork traceability by co-leading QRiosity, a blockchain-backed **MERN** platform, and designing and building its 5+ custom trace apps; adopted across 3+ supply chains and winner of 1st prize at the inaugural Inspiring Futures event (UAE).
Reached farmers in Maharashtra with limited tech experience by building a **React Native** Android app and a **PWA** with multilingual (**i18n**) support.
Led front-end development of the Invento ERP, covering inventory, invoicing and throughput estimation, with **React**, **Redux** and **Ant Design**.
Trained 30+ interns in **React** through hands-on bootcamps, from fundamentals to advanced patterns.
Promoted from Front-End Developer Intern in April 2020.

Built DhammaEdicts, a **MERN** web app (**React**, **Redux**, **Node.js**, **Express**, **MongoDB**) storing the Buddhist Tripitaka scriptures on a blockchain, inaugurated by the Dalai Lama at the Global Buddhist Congregation 2019.
Co-implemented authentication and authorisation with **JWT** to secure access to the platform.
Built the corporate website for Sahyadri Farms, India's leading Farmer-Producer Organisation, reaching ~10K impressions per month.
Built the HortiSquare farmer-outreach website, letting farmers apply for skill training and incubation.
Worked alongside tech entrepreneurs through team exercises, presentations and seminars to turn proposed solutions to real-world problems into software.
Designed and co-developed an **Android** app and website for an acupressure practice, letting patients book appointments and practitioners manage reports.
